mapper.select: SELECT i.owner_id,i.id AS item_id,v.id AS version_id,i.status FROM knowledge_item i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id JOIN knowledge_version adopted ON adopted.owner_id=i.owner_id AND adopted.item_id=i.id AND adopted.id=#{versionId} WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{itemId} AND v.version_number >= adopted.version_number
SELECT FROM review_basis_generation WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_kind=#{kind} AND source_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM review_basis_generation WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_kind=#{kind} AND source_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.owner_id,c.source_kind,c.source_id,c.generation,c.change_kind, c.previous_version_id,c.current_version_id,c.previous_status,c.current_status,c.created_at,c.upstream_version_id FROM review_basis_change c JOIN knowledge_version adopted ON adopted.owner_id=c.owner_id AND adopted.item_id=c.source_id AND adopted.id=c.upstream_version_id JOIN knowledge_version cited ON cited.owner_id=c.owner_id AND cited.item_id=c.source_id AND cited.id=#{versionId} AND cited.version_number >= adopted.version_number WHERE c.owner_id=#{owner} AND c.source_kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND c.source_id=#{id} AND c.generation > #{baseline} AND c.change_kind='KNOWLEDGE_UPSTREAM_CHANGED' ORDER BY c.generation LIMIT 1
